Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values
  • Class
    Description
    Callable
    Marker for every Mandela value that can be called: a script closure, a bound method, or a function the host contributed.
    MandelaClass
    A declared type: the runtime object behind class, type and enum.
    MandelaClass.Kind
    Which kind of declared type this is.
    MandelaClosure
    A script function value: a compiled body plus the variables it closed over.
    MandelaError
    A Mandela error: a value in the script and the throwable that unwinds the machine, in one object.
    MandelaInstance
    An instance of a declared type.
    MandelaIterator
    The cursor a for loop drives.
    MandelaList
    A Mandela list: an ordered, mutable sequence of values, written [1, 2, 3].
    MandelaMap
    A Mandela map: an insertion-ordered set of string-keyed values, written { "name": "Ada", score: 7 }.
    MandelaRange
    A Mandela range: a..b includes b, a..<b does not, and a..b step s produces every s-th value.
    Operators
    The operator meanings: what +, /, [i] and .length do to the values the machine puts in front of them.
    Ref
    A mutable cell holding one variable's value.
    Values
    The value semantics of Mandela in one place: what a value is called, when it is true, how it prints, how it compares, how it converts and how arithmetic behaves on it.
